people.name: Alondra Perez
people.description: Heyy! I’m a senior at Brown University concentrating in computer science and interested in the interaction between society and technology, which is why I’m going into software engineering. Outside of CS, I love hobby-maxxing, especially arts and crafts!

people.description: HI! I am a senior at Brown University studying Environmental Science with a minor in Data Science. I love to hangout with friends and drink boba.
